test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

After the scandal, the king was left with no choice but to announce his __act of renouncing the throne__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Abdication**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Abdication **means renouncing or giving up a high position or authority. (किसी उच्च पद या अधिकार को त्यागना या छोड़ देना) • **Example**: *The monarch's unexpected abdication left the kingdom in a state of uncertainty and transition.* • It is the most appropriate one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the given sentence. • The use of "**but**" in the sentence indicates that the king had no other option but to give up the throne. • Grammatically, "**act of renouncing the throne**" is a noun phrase, which can be replaced by a single noun, i.e., **abdication**. Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Coronation **means the ceremony of crowning a monarch. (किसी राजा का राज्याभिषेक करने का समारोह) • **Extradition **means the action of extraditing a person accused or convicted of a crime. (किसी अपराध के आरोपी या दोषी व्यक्ति को प्रत्यर्पित करने की कार्रवाई) • **Exoneration **means the act of absolving someone from blame or fault. (किसी को दोष या दोष से मुक्त करने की क्रिया) 44:Ta74, The correct answer is: **Unequivocal**
